name: BirbNation
description: BirbNation is a 2,222-piece collection of looping round-borb robin PFP GIFs on Robinhood Chain. Each birb is stacked from four layers — field, plumage, mug, and accent — then flattened onto one 12-frame GIF. Painted 3D illustration. Warm key. Soft clay volume. Chocolate cap. Burnt-orange chest. Cream belly. A pink blep.
